description: Manage persistent multi-session task dependency graphs (`create`, `decompose`, `next`, `update`, `tree`), returning unblocked next tasks and automatically propagating failure blockers. Use for multi-step project roadmaps across sessions; use `oxyo_remember_episode` for single-step logs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete verification condition defining when the goal is complete.

action.description: Operation: 'create' goal, 'decompose' into subgoals, 'next' unblocked tasks, 'update' status, or 'tree'.

chain_sequentially.description: Automatically wire each decomposed subgoal to depend on the preceding subgoal.

depends_on.description: List of prerequisite goal IDs that must complete before this goal unblocks.

evidence.description: Verification output, commit hash, or test summary recorded on status update.

failure_cause.description: Root-cause label logged to the causal graph when updating status to 'failed'.

goal_id.description: Target goal ID for 'decompose', 'update', or subtree inspection.

limit.description: Maximum number of unblocked tasks returned when action='next'.

parent_id.description: Optional parent goal ID when creating a nested sub-goal.

priority.description: Scheduling priority from 0.0 (low) to 1.0 (urgent) used to rank 'next' tasks.

prospective_trigger.description: Optional context cue or file/topic pattern that surfaces this goal automatically.

scope.description: Optional project/repo scope for isolating goal trees.

status.description: New lifecycle state applied to `goal_id` when action='update'.

title.description: Concise actionable goal title (required when action='create').

name: oxyo_goal
